detail.title: Synthesis of Accountability Mechanisms in Autonomous Systems
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes the current status of the responsibility formation project, emphasizing the formal governance role of ethics-based auditing and the structural challenges posed by autonomy. The research revises the notebook on accountability in automated decision-making to incorporate recently collected evidence regarding the intersection of cognitive decline and automated data gathering, as well as broader conceptual frameworks of autonomy.

children.title: Ethics-Based Auditing as a Governance Mechanism for Automated Systems

detail.title: Ethics-Based Auditing as a Governance Mechanism for Automated Systems
detail.summary: Ethics-based auditing (EBA) provides a formal, though 'soft', governance framework for automated decision systems. While autonomy is complex, EBA helps bridge the gap between automated outputs and decision-subject justifications by mandating consistent documentation and ethical deliberation at key intervention points.
detail.reason: Revision incorporating new evidentiary support for governance and autonomy.
